description: Get valid completions at a cursor position, from Godot's own completion engine. Returns: candidate labels with kind and detail. IMPORTANT: Uses ZERO-BASED coordinates. This is the only SCENE-AWARE query available: Godot resolves the scene that owns this script and completes against the real node, so $NodePath entries and the signals actually present on that node are included. No analysis of the .gd file alone can reproduce that.

file.description: Absolute or relative path to the .gd file

name: gdscript_complete
